multi_entity_note: Cargill, Incorporated and BioAmber S.A.S. (plus BRI and MCC mentioned); the file contains two amendment instruments.

contract.document_name.rationale: The document titles itself 'Amendment 1 to Development Agreement' and calls itself the 'First Amendment'; 'Development Agreement' is the underlying agreement and the second title belongs to a later separate amendment.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The First Amendment has no 'dated as of' date; it was signed by Cargill on 7/14/11 and fully executed when BioAmber signed on 7/18/11; April 15, 2010 is the underlying agreement's date and July 5, 2011 is the effective date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The First Amendment 'will be effective as of July 5, 2011'; April 15, 2010 dates belong to the underlying agreements and other dates are signing or period dates.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: No expiry date of a term is stated; September 30, 2011 ends only the period for additional FTEs.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: No renewal term is stated; the 30 days relates to ceasing BRI funding.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No notice period for non-renewal is stated.
